1: /**
2:  * dsh-native-pp-continuation — Route-A Runtime Continuation, round 2 (v5).
3:  *
4:  * Round 2 hardens the boundaries (docs/status/native-pp-rc-2026-09-02.md §8
5:  * follow-up), two axes:
6:  *
7:  * A. Runtime boundary:
8:  *    - unique: continuation fires ONLY when facts + contracts compress the
9:  *      legal next step to exactly ONE action (multi-contract uniqueness
10:  *      check; ambiguous -> record and hand back to the Model);
11:  *    - stale: CAS re-projection before dispatch; the stale intent is
12:  *      discarded and never executes (full-bump and partial-bump variants);
13:  *    - cancel: the dispatch uses the loop's own signal through the public
14:  *      boundary — cancellation materializes as the canonical aborted result,
15:  *      never a bypass;
16:  *    - guard: the dispatch passes the world's tools.guard; a denial is
17:  *      classified outcome "blocked" and surfaced to the Model;
18:  *    - unknown: missing facts -> needs-decision, never a takeover.
19:  * B. Fact boundary:
20:  *    - fact sources are gated (per-segment execution gate + read channels);
21:  *      misleading source literals (rcbait) and missing fact formats
22:  *      (rcnofacts) must produce ZERO takeovers.
23:  *
24:  * Chain (rchain only, bounded): after a dispatched hop the pre-step handler
25:  * re-projects and continues while exactly one fresh contract is required
26:  * (Runtime A -> Runtime B -> Model), then injects ONE combined digest message.
27:  *
28:  * The custom record kind "runtime/continuation" remains outside
29:  * KNOWN_SESSION_EVENT_TYPES (documented round-1 finding); replay verification
30:  * uses the independent decode path.
31:  */
32: import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
33: import { join } from "node:path";
34: import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";

36: export const name = "native-pp-continuation";
37: 
38: export const inject = ["tools"];
39: 
40: const MAX_CHAIN = 2;
41: const CAS_WAIT_MS = 4000;
42: 
43: /**
44:  * Contract table. required(projection) receives the projection (artifact,
45:  * runtime, executions, continuationSeq) and returns a boolean; action is the
46:  * unique deterministic next step. The narrow standard: the RUN is legal only
47:  * when exactly one contract is required.
48:  */
49: const CONTRACTS = {
50:   "plugin-revision-mismatch": {
51:     id: "plugin-revision-mismatch",
52:     kind: "revision",
53:     required: (proj) => proj.artifact !== null && proj.runtime !== null && proj.artifact.rev !== proj.runtime.rev,
54:     action: { name: "pwsh", arguments: { command: "& .\\reload.ps1", description: "Reload runtime to match artifact revision" } },
55:     factScripts: { artifact: ["build.ps1", "stale-bump-artifact.ps1"], runtime: ["verify.ps1", "reload.ps1", "stale-bump.ps1"] },
56:   },
57:   "plugin-revision-rollback": {
58:     id: "plugin-revision-rollback",
59:     kind: "revision",
60:     required: (proj) => proj.artifact !== null && proj.runtime !== null && proj.artifact.rev !== proj.runtime.rev,
61:     action: { name: "pwsh", arguments: { command: "& .\\rollback.ps1", description: "Roll the artifact back to the runtime revision" } },
62:     factScripts: { artifact: ["build.ps1"], runtime: ["verify.ps1", "reload.ps1"] },
63:   },
64:   "post-reload-healthcheck": {
65:     id: "post-reload-healthcheck",
66:     kind: "post",
67:     required: (proj) => proj.executions.has("reload.ps1") && !proj.executions.has("healthcheck.ps1"),
68:     action: { name: "pwsh", arguments: { command: "& .\\healthcheck.ps1", description: "Run the post-reload health check" } },
69:     factScripts: { artifact: [], runtime: [] },
70:   },
71: };

75:   rc: ["plugin-revision-mismatch"],
76:   rccancel: ["plugin-revision-mismatch"],
77:   rcguard: ["plugin-revision-mismatch"],
78:   rcmulti: ["plugin-revision-mismatch", "plugin-revision-rollback"],
79:   rcbait: ["plugin-revision-mismatch"],
80:   rcnofacts: ["plugin-revision-mismatch"],

87:   rccancel: { command: "& .\\reload-slow.ps1", description: "Reload runtime slowly to match artifact revision" },

113:   let text = "";
114:   for (const block of content) {
115:     if (block?.type === "text") text += String(block.text ?? "");

168:   /** Narrow fact-source gate: per command SEGMENT (split on ; | & newlines). */
169:   function pwshSegments(callArguments) {

171:       const parsed = JSON.parse(callArguments);
172:       return String(parsed?.command ?? "").split(/[;&|\r\n]+/);

196: 
197:   /**
198:    * Pure projection over the session event log (the ONLY fact source).
199:    * - artifact: latest "artifact=N" from a pwsh result that EXECUTES a
200:    *   fact-declared script (build.ps1 / stale-bump-artifact.ps1) in some
201:    *   segment, or latest "revision" from a read of artifact.json;
202:    * - runtime: latest "runtime_revision=N" from a pwsh result that EXECUTES
203:    *   verify/reload/stale-bump scripts, or from a read of runtime-state.txt;
204:    * - executions: scripts executed via pwsh (per-segment gate) — the durable
205:    *   "what ran" facts for post-conditions;
206:    * - continuationSeq: latest runtime/continuation seq per contract id.
207:    */
208:   function project(session) {
209:     const events = session.events;
210:     const callArgs = new Map();
211:     for (const event of events) {
212:       if (event.type === "tool/call" && event.data?.callId !== undefined) {
213:         callArgs.set(String(event.data.callId), {
214:           name: String(event.data.name ?? ""),
215:           arguments: String(event.data.arguments ?? ""),
216:         });
